# laravelforge_site_pulse (Data Source)

Fetches the Laravel Pulse integration status for a Laravel Forge site.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (String) Whether the Pulse integration is enabled.
- `pulse_installed` (Boolean) Whether Laravel Pulse is installed on the site.
